matches.title: Fallen Invasion Event (Continued)
matches.snippet: Forgot about it for a while. The Fallen Invasion is a concept event. It depicts an invasion made by the Fallen Race. It uses enemies from both Fallen and Hardcore Modes even if their names don't have the word 'fallen' in their names. It also features new enemies. You must be level 15 to play the event. You can earn the Battle Pass currency, Crystals, by playing the event, or by playing normal matches. You earn 100 for Normal Mode, 300 for Molten Mode, 500 for Fallen mode, and 1,000 for Hardcore Mode. All rewards are assuming you have triumphed. Unlike previous Battle Passes, rewards always carry over from the previous rank. For example, if you had 342 Crystals in Rank 4, and then earn 853 from a failed Hardcore run, you will have 1195 and then rank up with 595 left over. Battle Pass: Rank 1: Fallen Scout (not to be confused with SCT) - 100 Crystals Rank 2: 1,000 coins - 250 Crystals Rank 3: Premium Crate - 400 Crystals Rank 4: Fallen Militant - 600 Crystals Rank 5: Fallen Minigunner - 750 Crystals Rank 6: Premium Crate x2 - 900 Crystals Rank 7: Fallen Commander - 1,250 Crystals Rank 8: Fallen Crate - 1,500 Crystals Rank 9: Fallen Crook Boss - 1,750 Crystals Rank 10: Fallen Trophy - 1,800 Crystals The Rank 10 Reward will grant 25% more damage on all towers on Fallen and Hardcore modes, and 50% towards enemies which are considered 'Fallen'. matches.title: Swarmer fallen solo | No Accelerator, Ranger, Turret, or Minigunner
matches.snippet: That's right, Executioner is all you need for hidden detection, and while the triumph screen does hide the one in the top left corner, I only needed three maxed Executioners, and I guess a max Medic too, but it contributed basically nothing for damage. Executioner was my early game after tanking first 4 waves, although I'm pretty confident you can place it sooner and be fine in terms of farming for level 4 by wave 13. Why the Executioner is so efficient is because of the new targeting settings, specifically farthest, although last can also work pretty well on long straight paths if you have towers to cover leaked enemies (including hiddens), and even random can work somewhat well. This works because the Executioner hitting something with an axe only counts as a bounce once it has hit it's intended target at least once, then everything past that will be a bounce, or extra hit on either the target or other enemy, then return to the tower after using up all bounces. The hitbox of the axe is always active from the moment it is thrown though, so by setting the targeting to farthest or last and making sure the tower is placed a bit close to a straight path, you can set it up so it goes for a target pretty far from it where the axe will hit many other enemies while doing so without needing to return. matches.title: Farm lands fallen solo triumph, but I don't talk about it
matches.snippet: Another one. Yes, I forgot to sell the Farms. Not much to say about the solo, but doing these solos is starting to make me think a bit more. I'm starting to think Ranger might actually be better than Accelerator, just maybe. Either way, they make a great team. I need to get more experience with doing solos to truly know, but from my experience so far, the Accelerator is way better for most of the game, but when it comes to the boss wave, my Rangers seem to be a lot better due to the fallen guardians, and their range for attacking the boss as well. I think if the boss didn't have such powerful minions, then the Accelerators would be better due to their insane DPS, even with their range, but that is not the reality we are in, so Rangers seem to dominate for the boss wave. I think I'm still leaning towards Accelerator. It is also very likely just the map though, as Accelerator is best when it has lots of space to utilize, allowing it more time to charge up and allowing it to stay away from the fallen guardians attacks. I like to solo on less optimal maps, which is likely why I'm seeing results with the Ranger, as the Ranger can get more total damage in it's range, but of course it is dealt a lot slower. I also can't forget to mention that it will rarely ever get hit by attacks, and it will also entirely prevent leaking for the most part, although I don't really struggle with that

matches.title: The Solo Fallen pain.
matches.snippet: NOTE: IDK what is the point of the post lol Solo molten mode is easy. anyone with even minigunner can beat it if you spam a lot of them. But solo fallen is much much harder. You need the right towers, The right placement and the right time and also the right RNG. Mysteries will screw you over if you have bad RNG (this isn't a problem to 1 max gladiator as long as it's placed in a corner) then game over. Below is a list of the best towers used for each purpose. Early Game: Gladiator, Golden Scout, Minigunner (Only if you can survive wave 1-3 Abnormals), Golden Minigunner, Golden Cowboy, Military Base, Toxic Gunner. Economy: Farm, Golden Cowboy (Normal Cowboy is not recommended due to it's low damage and low range and low cash gain. ) Heavy Damage: Ranger, Accelerator (Worse than Ranger), Swarmer (Beehive Explosion Ability) Extra (Sub DPS): Golden Minigunner, Pursuit, Turret, Accelerator (Only if Ranger is your heavy damage tower) Extra (Support): Commander,DJ (What else would you use? Freezer?) Solo Fallen is a big pain. and here is a list of enemies that will take any opportunity to ruin your fun. #1 Fallen Guardian: Insane Health for Average Speed and spear ability with very low cooldown. WHY, THIS TANKS TOO MUCH HP FOR THE FALLEN KING #2 Mystery & Mystery Boss: Mysteries are very dangerous and unpredictable. Will 10 abnormal bosses spawn from mysteries on wave 18? or just a f

matches.title: Wave 40 with Swarmer and Golden minigunner solo
matches.snippet: This is the fastest solo strategy I've come up with yet, but sadly I haven't won yet. I'm actually thinking about replacing DJ with Medic, since it is very common for the Templar and Fallen king to stun my Swarmers, being unable to spam the beenade. Even if the guardians got through, I'm thinking the Swarmers can do enough DPS to kill the Fallen king if they are out of range, but very often they are stunned. My map choice was also not optimal, as while it has a pretty decent spot at the spawn to make for fast rounds, it isn't that efficient unless I'm using cliff units. I'm thinking I go with Harbor, or my favorite Autumn Falling, but that map generally takes longer due to the long space at the beginning. I could also just get the Accelerator and Golden Mini, as Accelerator isn't as reliable for killing Shadow bosses due to the lock-on feature; that is the reason why I used Golden Minigunner instead. Is this impressive? Probably not. Using Swarmers and Minigunners isn't exactly a new idea, as WikiaColors made a strat using both of them without support towers and with the normal Minigunner on Crossroads. I thought I could make a strat on a map with not as much space though to make things quicker, and of course use the Golden skin for optimal stats. Anyway, what should I replace my DJ with? Medic or Accelerator? I want suggestions. Wave 40 with Swarmer and Golden minigunner solo

matches.title: TDS Best Loadout (In general)
matches.snippet: Updated post for my old best loadout post Recommended Tower: Ranger as Main DPS Accelerator as Sub DPS Golden Minigunner as Sub DPS Turret as Sub DPS Pursuit as Sub DPS Farm as Economy Commander as Support DJ Booth as Support Gladiator as Early Game Golden Scout as Early Game Golden Cowboy as Early Game, Economy Ranger is the most reliable tower you ever need in your loadout, but the weaknesses is that it doesn't have Hidden Detection, which is where Sub DPS or Early Game comes in to play. Ranger needs Commander to be more reliable, DJ Booth comes in second, you don't need it as much as commander. With the power of Farm you can get Ranger faster, and even more fast with Golden Cowboy. Accelerator is not as reliable as Ranger, due to it's slow recharge, and also medium range. But, Accelerator will be more reliable if you use DJ Booth to help with the range. Ranger is still better than Accelerator due to better consistency. Accelerator still chew bosses that simple, you really need this for hard challenges. Golden Minigunner is probably the most recommended Sub DPS, with it's no placement limit while having good amount of DPS, the only weakness is Enemy with Defense so spam it. Turret is pretty good with Commander, it shred bosses easily, and it handles shielded enemy. The weakness is that it has placement limit. Turret have pretty good range, it can cover most of the map. matches.title: Wave 36 Toxic gunner, Ranger, Golden Soldier fallen solo without DJ
matches.snippet: I did it on Nether, I just wanted a more unique map. The main issue is my lack of firepower on the ground, as Rangers are easily doing most of the damage. Golden Soldiers DPS aren't the greatest, and I use them here for the Shadows. Toxic gunner is of course to slow down the boss and other enemies to keep in range for longer, and to do some decent damage as well, basically being an offensive substitute to the DJ. I accidentally skipped a wave like an idiot, which basically just guaranteed my loss, as I was already struggling. The Golden Soldiers do pretty awful against slow bosses, as do with the Toxic gunners, but they can keep them in range for longer. I had my Rangers set to strongest, but should I set them to first instead? Should I also get a more optimal map, or is it doable on a variety of maps? I just wish I got Golden Scout instead, due to the higher damage per shot, cheaper placement price, and cheaper upgrade prices, but I'm trying to make the best of what I got. matches.title: You can beat Fallen Mode solo without Commander
matches.snippet: Apparently, you can. Don't trust me? (Fandom sucks at loading image ngl tho) At wave 1 of the game, I realised that this would be also a; Placement Limit only Tower No Event Tower No Hardcore Tower No Golden Perks Which makes it even cooler (I guess?) However, I do lost 115 Base HP (and the minimum of Base HP you'll have is 106). But I done this on purpose so that I can have higher income on early game. You can perform this without losing that much of Base HP, but that requires some skills and lower early game income. Do note this loadout requires Turret and Mortar, both of them being a level unlock tower. So by unlocking Mortar on level 75, you're Base HP should be 130, so you're fine unless you paid for Mortar and Turret. Maps also plays an important role here. It's crazy that how Tower Defense Simulator has changed. Back in the good ol' days it was impossible to solo a match. This was later being possible after Crook Boss being added. Later, solo matches (duo and trio) has a cash wave buff. With the additional and buffs for towers makes soloing a match even possible and can be performed in many ways. Even with the cash wave buff and high DPS towers, Commander firerate buff still makes a major changes to the game. So winning a Fallen match solo without Commander was an achievement. During my run, I wasn't even struggling a bit. The game is somewhat... easy? I wouldn't say too

verified_top_matches.full_thread_text_excerpt: I did fallen without economy. Some people read the title and that's what you're here for, so I'll just get all the screenshots then I'll do the nerd talk where I might complain about things. Would recommend this challenge though, it's pretty fun This was the first attempt, it was a success, although not a surprise to me personally because I'm using Swarmer. A tower that most people might not think is a top tier, but it's the most cost efficient DPS in the entire game so it made perfect sense. This was just to see how possible moneyless fallen was, and yes that's the term I dubbed for this. I also have Gold Minigunner, so again, really cost efficient DPS just for hiddens. I did another Swarmer run later on, and the Swarmer runs were the only runs where I had enough money by the final wave to afford a Commander micro and Medic micro to place some more Swarmers. Here I just barely failed, the king entered with just around 10k health left. This is possibly the best map I could of chosen for this loadout since the crook minions cover the entire map and have surprisingly good range, the Rangers also cover the entire map, and the Crook boss early game spot and Ranger spot is so close I didn't even need to max the rest of the Commanders to reach all of the towers with the ability. The biggest problem was money, I couldn't max all Rangers until the boss had gotten really far onto the track, and the Toxic gunners, while helpful, were not necessary for other enemies. My mindset behind it was it slows everything down by 25% and I can spam it for lots of DPS, but I had so little money to even upgrade my Rangers that I couldn't do that and it didn't work out. Farm is meta for a reason, but fallen actually proves a very fun challenge for me going moneyless, pretty cool. I learned from my mistakes and decided to use Turret. I chose Turret because it has pretty huge map, having covered majority of the track by time it was maxed and there was a max DJ. I barely won though, fallen king was right in front of the exit with a few thousand health when I sold my Turrets to max the rest of them to make sure he died, then I sloppily placed them as you can see there, I only left one in the original Turret spot next to my early game spot. Not much more to say because I plan to talk about the moneyless challenge itself and what makes it challenging in the summary for nerds. This was my most recent win doing moneyless. I did the exact same thing as my first run except I replaced Gold Minigunner with Gold Crook boss instead to see if maybe I would lose to hidden enemies. It went basically exactly the same as last time, except one shadow boss did leak on wave 37 or 38, so I just placed a maxed Gold Crook boss at the end to kill it then moved it back. It leaked because my towers were stunned, and I only had one Medic that was recharging the ability (I couldn't afford a second one and I didn't have the money to just micro one). I also won with this loadout on my first attempt, so I think Swarmer is by far the best tower for this challenge and I'll talk about that a bit more in the nerd summary. Other attempts without screenshots I easily had more than half of my attempts using this one loadout, all of them having failed, and you might be surprised. Commander, DJ, Accelerator, Gold Scout, Medic; for the life of me, I could not get to wave 30 with this loadout, I also tried the same loadout but I replaced Gold Scout with Militant and I still failed. I was playing somewhat casually, if I'm in the mood I can keep trying this loadout, but I just couldn't do it. Gold Scout dominated early game, not much surprise, probably one of, if not the best early game for moneyless, Accelerator itself was the problem. While Accelerator is no doubt one of the best towers in the game at max level, the levels before it aren't really worth it if you think about it. They aren't awful, they can kill and it gets hidden detection completely free, but a Minigunner, gold variant, or even a Militant can get much better damage worth than an Accelerator from the early levels and are still viable at max. I died on wave 27 two times, one because my Accelerator placement wasn't great since I hoped I could max it to cover a good majority of the track on harbor and the Gold Scouts could carry, that did not work. The other loss, which was much more frustrating, was that I placed Accelerator in the perfect early game position on harbor, and that placement also was my downfall on wave 27 because he ended up targeting the slow boss and the glitches killed me again when that's exactly what I was trying to counter.... rough. I can probably try again and place it a little lower so the slow boss does

verified_top_matches.snippet: That's right, Executioner is all you need for hidden detection, and while the triumph screen does hide the one in the top left corner, I only needed three maxed Executioners, and I guess a max Medic too, but it contributed basically nothing for damage. Executioner was my early game after tanking first 4 waves, although I'm pretty confident you can place it sooner and be fine in terms of farming for level 4 by wave 13. Why the Executioner is so efficient is because of the new targeting settings, specifically farthest, although last can also work pretty well on long straight paths if you have towers to cover leaked enemies (including hiddens), and even random can work somewhat well. This works because the Executioner hitting something with an axe only counts as a bounce once it has hit it's intended target at least once, then everything past that will be a bounce, or extra hit on either the target or other enemy, then return to the tower after using up all bounces. The hitbox of the axe is always active from the moment it is thrown though, so by setting the targeting to farthest or last and making sure the tower is placed a bit close to a straight path, you can set it up so it goes for a target pretty far from it where the axe will hit many other enemies while doing so without needing to return. The hitbox of the axe is always active from the moment it is thrown though, so by setting the targeting to farthest or last and making sure the tower is placed a bit close to a straight path, you can set it up so it goes for a target pretty far from it where the axe will hit many other enemies while doing so without needing to return. verified_top_matches.title: Farm lands fallen solo triumph, but I don't talk about it
verified_top_matches.snippet: Another one. Yes, I forgot to sell the Farms. Not much to say about the solo, but doing these solos is starting to make me think a bit more. I'm starting to think Ranger might actually be better than Accelerator, just maybe. Either way, they make a great team. I need to get more experience with doing solos to truly know, but from my experience so far, the Accelerator is way better for most of the game, but when it comes to the boss wave, my Rangers seem to be a lot better due to the fallen guardians, and their range for attacking the boss as well. I think if the boss didn't have such powerful minions, then the Accelerators would be better due to their insane DPS, even with their range, but that is not the reality we are in, so Rangers seem to dominate for the boss wave. I think I'm still leaning towards Accelerator. It is also very likely just the map though, as Accelerator is best when it has lots of space to utilize, allowing it more time to charge up and allowing it to stay away from the fallen guardians attacks. I like to solo on less optimal maps, which is likely why I'm seeing results with the Ranger, as the Ranger can get more total damage in it's range, but of course it is dealt a lot slower. I also can't forget to mention that it will rarely ever get hit by attacks, and it will also entirely prevent leaking for the most part, although I don't really struggle with that

verified_top_matches.snippet: This is the fastest solo strategy I've come up with yet, but sadly I haven't won yet. I'm actually thinking about replacing DJ with Medic, since it is very common for the Templar and Fallen king to stun my Swarmers, being unable to spam the beenade. Even if the guardians got through, I'm thinking the Swarmers can do enough DPS to kill the Fallen king if they are out of range, but very often they are stunned. My map choice was also not optimal, as while it has a pretty decent spot at the spawn to make for fast rounds, it isn't that efficient unless I'm using cliff units. I'm thinking I go with Harbor, or my favorite Autumn Falling, but that map generally takes longer due to the long space at the beginning. I could also just get the Accelerator and Golden Mini, as Accelerator isn't as reliable for killing Shadow bosses due to the lock-on feature; that is the reason why I used Golden Minigunner instead. Is this impressive? Probably not. Using Swarmers and Minigunners isn't exactly a new idea, as WikiaColors made a strat using both of them without support towers and with the normal Minigunner on Crossroads. I thought I could make a strat on a map with not as much space though to make things quicker, and of course use the Golden skin for optimal stats. Anyway, what should I replace my DJ with? verified_top_matches.full_thread_text_excerpt: Welcome, let's see these two champs go against Fallen Mode! They will be sub DPS within the same loadout. (Engineer, DJ Booth, Ranger, Farm.) The only difference being that only one of them is in the first slot for their turn. Placement is different for both, since they have different range rings. I will put them at spots where I believe to be optimal for that tower. I equipped every default skin for each tower. (Except for Golden Minigunner. Because... He's Golden Minigunner...) Now with all of that out of the way, let's see who wins! First up, we have Accelerator. Let's see how he performs, in Solo. First off, early defense will always be Engineer. As both towers are not early game towers. Haha, loser squire- Got a Ranger and Accelerator down at wave 18. Mainly to clean up Fallen Jester and Ranger is there to boost its range. It seems to be 21.85 as of level 3 being boosted. And I must say, this range sucks... No seriously, do you not see how small that covers the first path? It's not that great, and it doesn't seem good for the Golden Minigunner once it's his turn. Regardless, at least it reaches the front. Level 3 Accelerator has a range of 19. I did Accelerator first to test out how big the range is. And it doesn't seem that versatile for that area. For Accelerator, it'll get better when it's maxed. But I'll have to think about it with the Golden Minigunner. Now, for the next level. Now THIS is much better to work with. Almost reaches the entrance and is almost basically full map range with the Ranger's range boost. Not bad, not bad at all. Continuing on with absolute domination. Oh boy, Fallen Tank. Let's see how well you fair against my Accelerators! Oh... So... Sad... And pathetic. Nothing is safe. And I mean it. This was Fallen Summoner before he met the heat death of the universe. And this was Fallen Summoner after meeting the infinite vessel of destruction for three seconds. Rip bozo. Moving on, Fallen Honor Guard came in. Then lost, half of his health by literally existing and getting beamed first. How sad. More random captures. If you're wondering what that is, that's a Fallen Summoner. As for wave 39, it wasn't hard at all. (Of course it isn't.) I just didn't get a capture of destroying it. Now, before getting to wave 40, I'll summarize what Accelerator has done. Most of the waves get spawnkilled instantly with Accelerator. Even wave 39 gets spawnkilled before Fallen Guardians spawned. Accelerator's role as a sub DPS is pretty huge, I kinda recommend it if you need a sweeper. Is it the best? Well, we'll have to see until the end. Now for wave 40, also known as the final wave. We're greeted with a Fallen Shield straight into my face. How cool. And then the Fallen Honor Guard. And then a swarm of Fallen Angels. And lastly, the Fallen King himself. I tried to get a good fudging capture. But I couldn't, because Engineer and Accelerator keep spawncamping EVERYTHING! Doesn't matter. This is good enough. Very good enough. Oh yes! So, he got destroyed. He is not happy. He died on the first turn. No seriously, it's the first turn. As in, the first turn he does on the path of the map... You get what I mean... So with that, Accelerator performed very well for a tower with an eight placement limit. Now, let's move on to our next challenger! The Golden Minigunner. It is time. First off, we know it's Engineer that defends early. But before we move straight to the Minigunner. I got a visual bug? Floating phantom/ghost berries... Anyway. We got the first level 3 Golden Minigunner for wave 18- Oh my goodness, that range is so horrendous... That's like... So terrible from where he is right now... This was quite hard to make him fit. Especially when there's 15 of these guys. Regardless, he isn't Accelerator, so I set him to strongest for Fallen Jester. He did... Decent. Instead of leveling or prioritizing Golden Minigunner like what I did with Accelerator, I upgraded my Engineers instead. It's just because she is the one who has to catch enemies that leak or go to the back. Because the Golden Minigunner can't reach that far... Besides that, I got a Ranger to buff his range. He reaches him, thank goodness for that. After decimating his foes, let's see what's his extra range is next wave. It has to be better! So this is him without the buff. And now, we have- You've got to be kidding me... Well... That's... An improvement?... Okay, I know this look as bad as how level 3 Accelerator was, who was placed farther back. But hey, he's not at his max level, let's not get too hasty on the guy. Now for the max level, we have something better. Yes! He hits the other curve! Too bad bad it only lasts for 20 seconds- At least he has more range towards the entrance. Moving on, more images. The Fallen Tank?! I see that you have returned! Now, are you any better than before? . . . oof... Placed another Golden Minigunner at the back. Is it any good? Well.. It barely reaches the start. But hey, we have the range boost for 20 second
